tests.description: Two-step sequence: constant medium then sine medium, same direction.
Sine starts, triangle joins after 1s and overlaps for 2s.
Constant and sine start together in orthogonal directions.
Spring and damper conditions running simultaneously.
Four constants played one after another in 0/90/180/270 degrees.
Ramp up then hold with constant effect.
Two sines with different phases, back to back.
Inertia and friction condition effects running together.
Length variation sequence: constant 8000ms then sine 8000ms with a small gap.
Length variation sequence: two long constant effects of 10000ms and 5000ms with partial overlap.
Four periodic effects with staggered starts creating a 4-way overlap window.
Four constant forces in cardinal directions all active simultaneously.
Sine base force with spring, damper, and friction conditions enabling a 4-way overlap.
Sixteen constant forces with varied directions and levels all starting at t=0 to exercise the 16-parallel-force limit.
